topic: Foundations of Linear Algebra: From Spans to Bases

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Vector as an Instruction
lecture_lines: Vectors act as instructions in space.
animations: 1. Display a 2D vector as an instruction arrow using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pencil.svg] to draw it. Color: #FFD700 (Gold).
2. Show components x and y of the vector using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] to measure lengths. Color: #00BFFF (Deep Sky Blue).
3. Shift vector origin to demonstrate translation. Color: #FF4500 (Orange Red).
4. Animate scaling the vector by a scalar. Color: #32CD32 (Lime Green).
5. Visualize vector addition as a path using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/protractor.svg] to verify the resulting angle. Color: #FF1493 (Deep Pink).

sections.title: Linear Combinations and Span
animations: 1. Display two basis vectors on the plane [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg]. Color: #FFD700 (Gold).
2. Draw linear combination as path of two vectors. Color: #00BFFF (Deep Sky Blue).
3. Highlight resulting grid points. Color: #FF4500 (Orange Red).
4. Fill the span area with light shading. Color: #32CD32 (Lime Green).
5. Show scaling basis vectors to fill plane [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg]. Color: #FF1493 (Deep Pink).

sections.title: Linear Dependence: The Redundant Vector
lecture_lines: They lie on the same span.
animations: 1. Show three vectors on a 2D plane using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] for measurement. Color: #FFD700 (Gold).
2. Demonstrate one vector as combination of others. Color: #00BFFF (Deep Sky Blue).
3. Fade out the redundant vector to clarify using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pencil.svg] to mark the final composition. Color: #FF4500 (Orange Red).

sections.title: Bases: The Minimalist Framework
animations: 1. Display two linearly independent vectors. Color: #FFD700 (Gold). [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vectors.svg]
2. Grid formed by these basis vectors. Color: #00BFFF (Deep Sky Blue). [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg]
3. Show how any point is reachable. Color: #FF4500 (Orange Red). [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/points.svg]

sections.title: Synthesis and Summary
animations: 1. Recap basis vectors and coordinate grid using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]. Color: #FFD700 (Gold).
2. Summarize linear combinations and span. Color: #00BFFF (Deep Sky Blue).
3. Final view of vector space structure using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]. Color: #FF4500 (Orange Red).
